subject: POC kickoff — working session preflight, prompt run, and load test coordination
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@brightlayer.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood POC — kickoff & working session availability

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We'd like to kick off a short POC to validate: prompt routing under our multi-tenant prompts, end-to-end latency with our routing policy, and a scaled load test for peak-hour inference.

High-level goals for the hands-on session (2.5 hours):
- Walk through prompt templates and prompt review (prompt_test_matrix).
- Validate routing: policy-based routing to dedicated vs fallback model.
- Run controlled load tests (50->1k rps ramp) and capture latency percentiles.

Can we schedule a working session next week? Prefer afternoons (PST). We also want to invite our infra lead (Tom Haggerty).

Pre-reads we'd find useful: a short runbook, an explicit checklist for provisioning test env, and a sample prompt test matrix. If you have those, please share.

Samira Khan
Director, Data Platform
BrightLayer Analytics
attachments: none (will accept your runbook/agenda)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — kickoff & working session availability

Hi Samira — great to hear and excited to run this with your team.

We can do a 2.5 hour hands-on session on either:
- Tue 2027-04-20, 1:00–3:30pm PT
- Thu 2027-04-22, 11:00am–1:30pm PT

Proposed working session agenda (draft):
1) 10m Quick intros & success criteria alignment
2) 25m Prompt review & prompt_test_matrix walkthrough
3) 35m Routing policy demo (dedicated vs fallback) + config steps
4) 50m Load test: small-to-medium ramp + live metrics review
5) 20m Post-mortem & next steps (rollout checklist, metrics to track)

I've attached: POC_Runbook_v1.docx, prompt_test_matrix.csv, preflight-checklist.md. Marcus, Monica — can you confirm infra availability for the 22nd if Samira confirms? We will need: a dedicated test pool, short-lived credentials, and a metrics collection hook (prometheus endpoint).

Samira — if the 22nd works, we'll version the agenda and send final pre-reads.

Attachments: POC_Runbook_v1.docx (docx), prompt_test_matrix.csv (csv), preflight-checklist.md (md)

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood POC — kickoff & working session availability

Naomi / Monica — quick internal runbook notes so we're aligned before the customer confirms: 
- Provision dedicated GPU pool (g4dn-equivalent) in us-west-2 for test window (22 Apr, 10:30–14:00 PT to allow warm-up).
- Pre-cache common prefixes and KV caches for the prompt_test_matrix. Marcus to run a 15-minute warm-up job at T-30m.
- Prepare routing policy snippets (canary rule + fallback). I'll add sample Terraform fragments to the drive.
- Load test plan: ramp 50 -> 1000 rps over 20 minutes with 5-minute steady state; capture p50/p90/p99 and token-costs.

I'll update the shared folder with the infra checklist by EOD.

Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Engineer

To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Thanks — quick update from our side: Tom (infra lead) has a conflict on the 20th and prefers Thu the 22nd. Can we lock Thu 2027-04-22, 11:00–1:30pm PT?

Also adding one more stakeholder: procurement contact (procurement@brightlayer.com) so they can observe the environment and confirm any needed firewall egress rules.

If you can push the updated agenda and a single-file pre-read bundle, that would be ideal. We'll review and circulate internally.

Samira

Hi Samira / Tom — confirmed: Thu 2027-04-22, 11:00am–1:30pm PT. Thank you for the quick turn.

Updated notes and logistics:
- Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/poc-20270422 (dial-in + meeting notes live doc)
- Final agenda attached as POC_Agenda_v3.pdf (single-file pre-read bundle)
- Preflight checklist: preflight-checklist.md (see "network" section — add procurement contact to firewall allowlist if needed)
- Prompt test matrix: prompt_test_matrix.csv (we highlighted 12 canonical prompts you'll want to run during the session)
- Runbook: POC_Runbook_v1.docx (sections: env provisioning, routing snippets, fallback flows)

Infra commitments (from Marcus): pool provisioned in us-west-2; warm-up scheduled at 10:25am; monitoring endpoint will be available at /metrics for the duration.

Load test plan (short):
- Ramp 50 -> 1,000 RPS over 20 minutes; steady-state 5 minutes; capture p50/p90/p99 and token-cost per-minute.
- We'll also run a short burst test with cached prefixes to demonstrate cost delta with KV-cache warming.

Action items before session:
- Naomi: send calendar invite with dial-in and drive links (done).
- Marcus: upload terraform snippets and warm-up script to the drive (INF-742).
- Samira/Tom: confirm procurement firewall allowlist by 2027-04-21 EOD.

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v3.pdf (pdf) — single bundle with agenda + pre-reads

Looking forward to it. If anything changes I'll ping the thread.

Best,
